import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms'; @Component({ selector: 'app-assignments-admin', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule], template: `

📝 Assignments

{{editingId ? 'Edit' : 'Add New'}} Assignment

TitleCourseDue DateStatusMarksActions
{{a.title}}{{a.course}}{{a.dueDate}} {{a.status}} {{a.marks}}
` }) export class AssignmentsAdminComponent { showForm = false; editingId: number | null = null; formData = { title: '', course: '', dueDate: '', status: 'Pending', marks: 100, description: '' }; assignments: any[] = [ { id: 1, title: 'Java OOP Assignment', course: 'Java Full Stack', dueDate: '20 Jan 2026', status: 'Graded', marks: 100, description: 'Implement OOP concepts' }, { id: 2, title: 'SQL Queries Lab', course: 'Database Management', dueDate: '22 Jan 2026', status: 'Pending', marks: 50, description: 'Write SQL queries' }, { id: 3, title: 'React Components', course: 'Web Development', dueDate: '25 Jan 2026', status: 'Submitted', marks: 100, description: 'Build React components' }, ]; save() { if (this.editingId) { const i = this.assignments.findIndex(a => a.id === this.editingId); if (i > -1) this.assignments[i] = { ...this.formData, id: this.editingId }; } else { this.assignments.push({ ...this.formData, id: Date.now() }); } this.resetForm(); } edit(a: any) { this.editingId = a.id; this.formData = { ...a }; delete (this.formData as any).id; this.showForm = true; } delete(a: any) { if (confirm('Delete?')) this.assignments = this.assignments.filter(x => x.id !== a.id); } resetForm() { this.formData = { title: '', course: '', dueDate: '', status: 'Pending', marks: 100, description: '' }; this.editingId = null; this.showForm = false; } }
